outcome.technical: stamp-verification.py: new code_sha (a Python file's token stream without COMMENT/NL tokens; bytes for a non-Python file or one that does not tokenize, prefix code:sha256: when it is the code reading) and code_digest (test_digest's shape via a new optional read= argument); leg_inputs reads laid-over files through code_sha for CODE_KEYED_LEGS (task, task-held, task-support) and through bytes for every other leg; LEG_KEY_VERSION 1 -> 2 so no byte-keyed entry answers; run_red reports testCodeDigest in the payload and appends code_key_clause to the basis of any block whose proof made or replayed a task leg (names the code digest and the limit: a test reading its own comments or line numbers). testDigest, the drive's lock and the stamp (take, _tree_stamp) stay on bytes. drive-phase.py: hold_proof keeps testCodeDigest as proof.testCode; new tests_drift (the one spelling of the test-file drift phrase, now used by tree_since_proof), comment_only (changed paths whose held and re-proved code digests are equal), task_leg_word (replayed/ran off the helper's legs); prove_and_hold rewords the drift after the re-proof and note_reproof says 'outside their code (comments only)' and the task leg's fate. DEVIATION from the description: tree_since_proof itself does not say 'comments only' before the re-proof - the drive is an entry point that may not import stamp-verification and holds no tokenizer, and a second copy of code_sha in the drive would be two homes for one fact (a shared lower-layer module would be a file outside this task's files). The phrase is produced by prove_and_hold right after the helper reports the code digest; the behavioural saving (task leg not rerun) comes from the helper's leg store keyed on code, which prove_and_hold's re-proof reaches. Docs: module docstrings of both scripts, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md stamp-verification section (new paragraph + the T3 field list corrected), changelog.d/P173.4.changed.md. Tests: lr15 (sr-leg-inputs), lr16 (sr-leg-reuse), cq1/cq2 (ux-block in test_drive_phase.py). After: 9/9 and 137/137. In-process mutations (no tree edit): fix leg code-keyed -> lr15 red; task leg on bytes -> lr15 red; code_sha returning bytes -> lr15 red; comment_only always all -> cq2 red; never -> cq1 red. Known limit (in the basis): a test reading its own comments or line numbers; a replayed task leg's output text carries the line numbers of the run it replays.
outcome.descriptive: A comment-only edit to a task's test files replays the red-first task leg instead of rerunning it; the proof's basis names the code digest and its limit, and the drive's re-proof note says the change was comments only.
